decision: Support non-promotion; no demonstrated false numerical claim on the evidence currently identified.
read_extent: All seven original submission pages read as extracted text; both original BNetzA auction-result press releases read in full substantive text; BT 21/8238 operative physical pages 16–18 and 22–23 read. No full bill read.
checks: The immediate context concerns capital costs and refinancing auction payments, so an economic present-value convention is a substantive alternative to nominal winning-payment totals. Both original releases expressly spread the electricity-cost component over twenty years after completion.

The two observed non-central auction totals do not reproduce EUR 750m per GW on a nominal capacity-weighted winning-award basis. That is a conditional mismatch, not a uniquely identified correction of the unspecified average.

The surrounding argument most naturally concerns successful award payments rather than every unsuccessful intermediate bid, but that reading is insufficient to resolve omitted cohorts, weighting and discounting.
The closest bill has the two-stage design and sections discussed, but the original does not identify the exact date or Bundestag number. Exact-version limitation remains.
The alternative policy design and international-market attractiveness arguments include forecasts and implicit market/time scope. They are not established false by this audit.
limits: No actual financial burden, corrected historical average, auction attractiveness or author intent established. Review does not certify every statement in the original.
